Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. 2026-07-28: the serious logic-and-methodology audit ran as five parallel read-only reviewers (logic, maths, order-of-operations, overfitting/leakage, statistics), covering the three lenses the final-audit-panel rule required, with nothing launched or edited and all numbers recomputed from disk. Biggest finding - the working tree is not the measured code: v3/pipelines/artefact_v1.py carried an uncommitted ~1000-line rewrite, newer than the newest state doc and covered by no state doc, in which only the description path admits chunks into the kept set, normalization is hard-coded to the sweep-measured losing mode, and all HERB_* combine and walk flags are deleted, making clusterKglob 0.7492 unimplementable in it. Its one measured run is detDESCFIRST gold-100 0.6251 against the committed baseline 0.7339, a -0.109 regression, with a new arithmetic bug: tag and desc pools extend to 256 rows over 6 levels but normalize against a fixed 4-level reference, so equal-distance scores drift 0.50 to 0.60 to 0.69 with pool width while stated-scope stays 0.50. All measured results live at HEAD commit 5006fed

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. Statistical verdicts per shipping claim, n=100 paired, sign-flip permutation plus BCa CI plus Holm. The headline 0.64 vs 0.09/0.11 is ~85% unit artifact - crediting one id per kept chunk drops the artefact to 0.0904, about lucene - and ships only as a matched-id-budget comparison, 0.73-0.75 vs 0.41/0.39/0.27, roughly 1.8x, all Holm p about 3e-4. 'Leads all valid metrics' is false as worded: answer_correctness vs vector is n.s. at p=0.096 and generator-confounded. The +0.030 combine rebuild is REAL, p=0.0005, CI +0.014..+0.054 - a defect fix, not a swept knob. 'clusterKglob best config' is NOT supported: +0.0154 over detCUR at p=0.36, smaller than best-of-36 selection noise, with worse ordering. Cluster-K's K-decision is structurally inert at k=50 - stops fired 100/100 yet semantic >=122 everywhere, so kept=50 always. Curve-walk 0.51 vs constant-cut 0.65 is n.s. at n=10, exact p=0.203. Facets ship as a bounded failure-to-detect, +/-0.035, not a point null. The ~0.80 wall is tried-set enumeration on n=10 and optimistically biased. Scope-dominance is haiku leg only, +0.077 global p=6e-4. haiku < det is supported on gold-100, -0.130 p=5e-5. Leakage: no direct answer-text leakage in any of 129 run dirs, but the arm resolves chunk text from full raw HERB at answer time, so quarantine rests on herb-eval locator discipline. Plus the landmine list: two different gold-100 sets, invalid flat-slice __k dirs, unusable partial JUDGE_* dirs, manifests with no git sha, k-dependent hybrid rankings, a question-id-keyed vector query-embed cache, and a haiku judge never validated on artefact-style contexts
